summary_brief: 今日 (2026-01-10) 发现 8 个 Commit 信号，12 个 Release 信号。

engineering_signals.title: MCP协议深度集成
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cline、Deer-Flow 和 OpenDevin 等多个头部项目同时推进 MCP (Model Context Protocol) 支持，标志着 AI 代理工具调用的标准化正在形成，解决了工具生态碎片化问题。

engineering_signals.title: 上下文截断优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Continue 针对长上下文场景实现了精细的截断策略（25k tokens 限制），这是解决 LLM 上下文窗口成本和延迟瓶颈的关键工程实践。

engineering_signals.title: OpenAI Responses API
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Python SDK 和 Zed 编辑器同时适配新的 Responses API（包含 completed_at 属性），表明 AI 编程工具正在向更细粒度的流式响应和元数据追踪演进。

engineering_signals.title: 代理安全加固
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: GPTme 实施了严格的安全措施，包括参数校验、错误信息清洗和黑名单检查，这对于拥有 Shell 权限的自主代理至关重要，防止注入攻击。

engineering_signals.title: Hook系统架构
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Gemini CLI 正在将核心逻辑（如聊天压缩、清除命令）迁移到统一的 HookSystem，这种插件化架构极大地提升了系统的可扩展性和可维护性。

engineering_signals.title: LangGraph状态管理
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: LangGraph 修复了深层图跳转时的命名空间清理问题，并支持 cron 任务完成回调，显示了复杂 AI 工作流框架在状态一致性上的持续投入。

engineering_signals.title: 可观测性增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 和 Cline 都在加强 OTEL (OpenTelemetry) 支持，添加了工具调用、审批和 MCP 调用的指标，这对于在生产环境中调试和优化 AI 代理行为至关重要。

research_signals.title: 子代理协作机制
research_signals.why_it_matters: Zed 引入 Subagents 概念并添加工具权限评估逻辑，OpenAI Codex 添加分层代理提示，这表明 AI 编程助手正从单体向多代理协作体系演进。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Merged slash commands and skills, simplifying the mental model with no change in behavior
- Added release channel (`stable` or `latest`) toggle to `/config`
- Added detection and warnings for unreachable permission rules, with warnings in `/doctor` and after saving rules that include the source of each rule and actionable fix guidance
- Fixed plan files persisting across `/clear` commands, now ensuring a fresh plan file is used after clearing a conversation
- Fixed false skill duplicate detection on filesystems with large inodes (e.g., ExFAT) by using 64-bit precision for inode values
- Fixed mismatch between background task count in status bar and items shown in tasks dialog
- Fixed sub-agents using the wrong model during conversation compaction
- Fixed web search in sub-agents using incorrect model
- Fixed trust dialog acceptance when running from the home directory not enabling trust-requiring features like hooks during the session
- Improved terminal rendering stability by preventing uncontrolled writes from corrupting cursor state
- Improved slash command suggestion readability by truncating long descriptions to 2 lines
- Changed tool hook execution timeout from 60 seconds to 10 minutes
- [VSCode] Added clickable destination selector for permission requests, allowing you to choose where settings are saved (this project, all projects, shared with team, or session only)

releases.summary:
## New Features
- Add conversation/thread fork endpoints in the protocol and app server so clients can branch a session into a new thread. (#8866)
- Expose requirements via `requirement/list` so clients can read `requirements.toml` and adjust agent-mode UX. (#8800)
- Introduce metrics capabilities with additional counters for observability. (#8318, #8910)
- Add elevated sandbox onboarding with prompts for upgrade/degraded mode plus the `/elevate-sandbox` command. (#8789)
- Allow explicit skill invocations through v2 API user input. (#8864)

## Bug Fixes
- Codex CLI subprocesses again inherit env vars like `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`/`DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH` to avoid runtime issues. As explained in #8945, failure to pass along these environment variables to subprocesses that expect them (notably GPU-related ones), was causing 10x+ performance regressions! Special thanks to @johnzfitch for the detailed investigation and write-up in #8945. (#8951)
- `/review <instructions>` in TUI/TUI2 now launches the review flow instead of sending plain text. (#8823)
- Patch approval “allow this session” now sticks for previously approved files. (#8451)
- Model upgrade prompt now appears even if the current model is hidden from the picker. (#8802)
- Windows paste handling now supports non-ASCII multiline input reliably. Special thanks to @occurrent laying the groundwork for this fix in #8021! (#8774)
- Git apply path parsing now handles quoted/escaped paths and `/dev/null` correctly to avoid misclassified changes. (#8824)

## Documentation
- App-server README now documents skills support and usage. (#8853)
- Skill-creator docs clarify YAML frontmatter formatting and quoting rules. (#8610)
